question: Which cloud, AI, LLM, storage or observability costs lack product or workflow owners?
allowed_evidence: Redacted spend categories; workload tags; owner map; anomaly notes; budget threshold screenshot
blocked_inputs: Production credentials; unredacted invoices; payment data; secrets
claim_boundary: No savings or ROI claim until buyer verifies baseline, action and result.

question: Which GDPR/DPIA, data-residency, processor or subprocessor questions need adviser review?
allowed_evidence: Questionnaire row; policy link; redacted DPIA gap note; adviser-needed flag
blocked_inputs: Patient records; personal data; unapproved legal advice; regulator submissions
claim_boundary: No legal or privacy conclusion by AICS.

question: Which security-questionnaire, ISO/SOC2/NHS DSPT or supplier evidence answers are blocked?
allowed_evidence: Approved answer source; evidence link; source owner; expiry date; missing-evidence note
blocked_inputs: GRC login; secrets; vulnerability detail not approved for sharing; unredacted audit evidence
claim_boundary: No security, audit or compliance proof claim by AICS.

question: Where could AI or automation affect patient communication or clinical/admin handoff?
allowed_evidence: Human-review rule; escalation path; redacted workflow step; prohibited claim list
blocked_inputs: Patient conversation; clinical notes; diagnosis/treatment detail; call recording
claim_boundary: No medical, clinical safety, AI accuracy or patient outcome claim.

question: Which route fits: patient platform, GRC/trust tool, FinOps platform, adviser or AICS evidence diagnostic?
allowed_evidence: Route comparison; decision owner; missing evidence; next-step expiry; board question list
blocked_inputs: Vendor NDA material not approved for sharing; unapproved rankings; pricing secrets
claim_boundary: No vendor superiority, replacement, top-ranking or procurement approval claim.
